title: Rig Relay Correlation Vocabulary
summary: Canonical correlation field vocabulary for all Rig Relay trace events. Defines field identity, ownership, propagation rules, and safety classification for every correlation ID used across traces. Does not require every field everywhere — the goal is semantic consistency, not stuffing every event with every ID.

fields.semantic_description: Whole launch/session/operation trace identity. Stable across all events in the same trace. Generated once per trace root.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated by root span creator (bridge server or agent loop). Propagated via TraceContext contextvars. Included in every RigTraceEvent. Never derived from user input.

references.description: Analogous to traceparent trace-id but Rig-owned format.

fields.semantic_description: Local span identity within a trace. Unique per operation span.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated per span via child_trace_context(). Parent span_id set as parent_span_id on children.

fields.semantic_description: Parent span identity for causal chain reconstruction.
fields.propagation_rules: Set on child spans via TraceContext.child(). Optional on root spans.

fields.semantic_description: Desktop bridge/frontend/WebSocket correlation ID. Connects backend bridge startup, WebSocket auth, and frontend breadcrumbs into one launch trace. Canonical source is backend-generated corr_* ID.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated by bridge_server at startup. Injected into frontend runtime config. Frontend sets via setFrontendHandshakeId() and includes in every recordFrontendEvent(). Backend websocket_server receives from auth message and uses for trace correlation. Must be identical across frontend and backend for the same launch.
fields.redaction_notes: Short hex token — safe to log but not a secret. Do not derive from auth token.

fields.semantic_description: Browser/frontend instance sub-ID for distinguishing reload cycles within the same handshake. Must not replace or duplicate handshake_id.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated by frontend on page load. Included in frontend breadcrumb events alongside handshake_id. Backend receives via /frontend-event but does not generate. Not required for backend-only traces.
fields.redaction_notes: Must not be a copy of handshake_id or auth token.

fields.semantic_description: Per-WebSocket connection identity. Distinguishes reconnect cycles within the same handshake session.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated per WebSocket accept. Present in websocket lifecycle events. Not propagated to frontend (frontend uses handshake_id). Backend uses to distinguish connection cycles.

fields.semantic_description: Rig Relay agent session identity. Persists across multiple turns within one agent conversation.
fields.propagation_rules: Set via TraceContext contextvar when agent session is active. Not present in desktop-bridge-only traces. Propagated to tool execution and context assembly spans.

fields.semantic_description: Durable job identity for fleet-coordinated work. Future: persists across machine restarts.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated by fleet coordinator when dispatching work. Present in coordination events. Not present in desktop bridge traces.

fields.semantic_description: Batch identity for a group of pending/executed tool calls dispatched together.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated when execute_tool_batch is invoked. Links all tool calls in one batch. Present in tool execution trace events.

fields.semantic_description: Individual tool call identity within a batch or standalone invocation.
fields.propagation_rules: Set via TraceContext contextvar during tool execution. Present in tool execution trace events and receipts.
fields.redaction_notes: Tool call UUID — safe to log.

fields.semantic_description: Agent or subagent identity within a session.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated by subagent runtime. Present in subagent trace events. Not present in main agent loop traces unless multi-agent.

fields.semantic_description: Worktree/lane identity for parallel agent work in isolated git worktrees.
fields.propagation_rules: Set via TraceContext._current_lane_id when worktree is active. Present in mutation and coordination events.

fields.semantic_description: Alias for lane_id in coordination and mutation contexts. Same identity, different naming convention.
fields.propagation_rules: Same as lane_id. Used in build_correlation() as worktree_id key.

fields.semantic_description: HTTP request identity for bridge server request tracing.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated per HTTP request to bridge. Not currently implemented. Would link HTTP serve events to trace spans.

fields.semantic_description: Code schema identifier selected by the context router for a given agent turn.
fields.propagation_rules: Set when code schema router selects schemas. Included in context assembly events. Links trace to governance artifacts.
fields.redaction_notes: Schema ID string — safe to log.

fields.semantic_description: Documentation/source artifact identity for rendered docs flow.
fields.propagation_rules: Present in docs render events. Links render output to source JSON documents.
fields.redaction_notes: Document ID string — safe to log.

fields.semantic_description: Git commit SHA of the repository HEAD at trace start.
fields.propagation_rules: Captured once at bridge startup. Included in golden path events. Not updated mid-trace.

fields.semantic_description: Alias for commit_sha. Same identity.
fields.propagation_rules: Same as commit_sha.

fields.semantic_description: Monotonic per-process event sequence number. Enables ordering within a single trace store write stream.
fields.propagation_rules: Incremented per write to trace store. Not propagated across processes.

fields.semantic_description: Monotonic frontend event sequence number. Orders frontend breadcrumbs within a page load.
fields.propagation_rules: Incremented per recordFrontendEvent() call. Included in frontend breadcrumb payload.

fields.semantic_description: Future backend event sequence number if per-process ordering is needed beyond JSONL line order.
fields.propagation_rules: Future: incremented per write. Not implemented.

fields.semantic_description: Frontend high-resolution monotonic-ish clock domain for intra-page timing. Uses performance.now() in browser.
fields.propagation_rules: Captured per frontend event. Not propagated to backend. Used for frontend-internal latency calculations.

fields.semantic_description: Backend monotonic clock domain for intra-process duration measurement. Uses time.monotonic_ns() in Python.
fields.propagation_rules: Captured at span start/end. Used for duration_ms calculation.

fields.semantic_description: ISO 8601 timestamp / wall-clock time for human-readable event ordering.
fields.propagation_rules: Generated per event at write time. Included in every RigTraceEvent as timestamp field.
